eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Summit, UT; at 8:51 PM on AUG 9, 2026 Effective until 9:51 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: East of 300 W in Henefer to I-84 is in 'Set' Status for possible evacuation from the Rocky Canyon Fire. Be Prepared to leave at a moment's notice. This is NOT an evacuation order. Load your vehicle with your go bag and essentials. Please do not call 911 for updates. Continue to monitor for official information available at https://www.summitcounty.info/emergency and Utah Fire Info.
